                .Include(v => v.Patient)
                .Where(v => !v.Visited && v.TenantId == tenantId)
                .Where(v => v.DateTime >= DateTime.UtcNow)
                .OrderBy(c => c.DateTime)
                .Take(count)
                .ToListAsync()

ORDER _context.HomeAppointments
                .Include(v => v.Patient)
                .Where(v => v.Visited && v.TenantId == tenantId)
                .Where(v => v.DateTime <= DateTime.UtcNow)
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.DateTime)
                .Take(count)
